checks.description: Primary keys are unique in every table
IDs follow the required zero-padded formats
Every foreign key points to an existing parent row (all joins valid)
Status/type fields only use allowed values
Dates and times are in a valid order (start before end)
Order totals = items x unit values
Delivery weight/volume/site/date match the order
Service minutes follow the documented formula
Shift minutes = end - start
Outcome delay/on-time values match arrival and window
Route stop count/weight/volume equal the sum of its stops
Stop arrival = previous departure + travel; departure = start + service
Every state change is an allowed transition
Last event state equals the entity's current status
Events are append-only, numbered 1..n and not going back in time
Route weight, volume and stop count fit the vehicle capacity
Vehicle is active and has a capacity row on the route date
Vehicle is not restricted from any stop's site
Driver licence allows the vehicle
Route fits inside the driver's shift (including return to depot)
Route shift belongs to the route driver and date
Service starts inside the delivery time window
A stop never arrives before the previous stop departs
A delivery appears at most once in a route
Every delivery assigned to a route has a stop in that route
Stop sequence numbers are exactly 1..n
A stop's delivery is assigned to the stop's route
A vehicle has at most one route per day
A driver has at most one route per day
Every delivery is assigned to a route OR explicitly unserved with a reason
Unserved/failure reason codes are in the allowed list
Failed outcomes have a reason; delivered outcomes have none
Delivered/failed deliveries have an outcome row
Outcomes match their delivery and stop (none for unserved deliveries)
Customer site coordinates are inside the defined region
Delivery was explicitly left unserved (reason code given)
Simulated route returned to depot after the shift end
